overview_description.description: Macromoltek does computational drug discovery for pharma companies, focusing on antibodies for therapeutics and diagnostics. This mother-daughter team’s approach aims to make research for everything from flu to cancer treatments an order of magnitude faster. With an accelerated process to discover antibodies, medical researchers can (1) craft targeted treatment plans for previously undruggable targets and (2) overcome patients’ drug resistance, a major challenge when treating diseases caused by bacteria, viruses, and parasites.

about_short_description.short_description: Macromoltek does computational drug discovery for pharma companies, focusing on antibodies for therapeutics and diagnostics.

product.name: Computational Antibody Design
product.description: A service that uses computational modeling to design custom antibodies rapidly, typically within one week.

product.name: Antibody Structure Improvement
product.description: A service focused on enhancing existing antibody structures to optimize their properties for therapeutic or diagnostic use.

product.name: Antibody Humanization
product.description: A service that modifies non-human antibodies to reduce immunogenicity by making them more similar to human antibodies.

product.name: Epitope Mapping of Antigens
product.description: A computational service that identifies the specific binding sites (epitopes) on antigens recognized by antibodies.

product.name: Solving Specific Antibody Design Problems
product.description: A consulting service that addresses particular challenges in antibody design using computational approaches.
